stem.text: The equation for a chemical reaction is shown. All substances are in their standard states.
Which statement describes the standard enthalpy change of reaction for this reaction?

A.text: the enthalpy change when a total of one mole of products is produced

B.text: the enthalpy change when a total of one mole of reactants is reacted

C.text: the enthalpy change when one mole of water reacts

D.text: the enthalpy change when six moles of hydrogen fluoride are produced
